g.text: Uno logical pin map: DOUT to Uno D0; DIN to Uno D1. J1 pin map: XBee DOUT goes to Uno D0/RX; Uno D1/TX reaches XBee DIN only through the adapter?s suitable level translator.

g.desc: Uno logical pin map: DOUT to Uno D0; DIN to Uno D1. J1 pin map: XBee DOUT goes to Uno D0/RX; Uno D1/TX reaches XBee DIN only through the adapter?s suitable level translator.

g.text: A bare XBee radio needs regulated 3.3 V; adapter boards differ. Match firmware, PAN ID, channel and baud on both radios. Physical radio link was not tested.
